title: Finitely many maximal ideals with locally nilpotent Jacobson radical make a ring a product of its localisations
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a ring with finitely many maximal ideals whose Jacobson radical is locally nilpotent is the product of its localisations at those maximal ideals, and that all its primes are maximal (statement lines 12974-12979). The proof does not invoke the classification of Artinian rings: it uses local nilpotence to show every prime contains the intersection of the maximal ideals and hence one of them, making the spectrum discrete, then splits the ring by a disjoint-support decomposition applied finitely many times and identifies the factors as the localisations (proof lines 12981-13001). The first step, which turns local nilpotence into discreteness of the spectrum, is the content, and the author writes it out. H2.
